questions.q: If two different food dyes produce the exact same Rf value using the exact same solvent and paper, what can be inferred?
a: They are likely to be the same chemical substance

The liquid with the highest density
The liquid with the lowest boiling point

questions.q: Why does a fractionating column have glass beads or plates inside it?
